# Vendored third-party code

Everything under `vendor/` is **code copied from other projects**, not written
for ignuda. It is kept here, unmodified except where noted, so ignuda can build
on it. Each crate also carries a provenance note in its `Cargo.toml` and the
top of its `lib.rs`.

## Source

All crates in this directory come from **ZLUDA** — Andrzej Janik's open-source
CUDA implementation:

- Repository: <https://github.com/vosen/ZLUDA>
- Commit: `86ec0a93cc83ba5b52e645892523e339dfa884f7` (2026-10-07)
- Licence: dual **Apache-2.0 OR MIT** — the same terms ignuda uses, so the code
  is included under those licences. Copyright remains with Andrzej Janik and
  the ZLUDA authors. See `/LICENSE-APACHE` and `/LICENSE-MIT`, and `/NOTICE`.

## What was taken and why

| crate | upstream | change on import | why ignuda wants it |
|-------|----------|------------------|---------------------|
| `ptx_parser` | `ptx_parser` | provenance header only | a mature, complete PTX parser — more capable than ignuda's own `crates/ptx` |
| `ptx_parser_macros` | `ptx_parser_macros` | provenance header only | proc-macros `ptx_parser` depends on |
| `ptx_parser_macros_impl` | `ptx_parser_macros_impl` | provenance header only | implementation crate for the above |
| `cuda_types` | `cuda_types` | ROCm stripped (see below) | complete, generated CUDA ABI (driver, cuBLAS, cuBLASLt, cuDNN, cuFFT, cuSPARSE, NVML, dark API types) — ignuda had only a hand-written subset |

### Modification to `cuda_types`

Upstream `cuda_types` is generated by ZLUDA's `zluda_bindgen` from NVIDIA's
public headers and is backend-independent, **except** for one trailing
`impl From<RocErrorType> for CudaErrorType` block per module that converts AMD
ROCm/HIP error codes into CUDA ones, plus the `cuda_macros` and ROCm `*-sys`
dependencies those blocks pulled in. ignuda targets Intel, not AMD, so those
8 `impl` blocks and all ROCm/`cuda_macros` dependencies were removed; the only
remaining dependency is `bitflags`. Nothing else was changed. The removal is
reproducible with `/scripts/strip_rocm.py` run over the upstream
`cuda_types/src/*.rs`.

## What was deliberately *not* taken

- `dark_api` (the crate): pulls in ZLUDA's `format` crate (~150k LOC) plus
  `rkyv`/`cglue` for something ignuda's own `crates/cuda/src/dark.rs` already
  implements. The dark-API *type definitions* we do want come in through
  `cuda_types::dark_api` instead.
- `zluda` runtime, `zluda_blas`/`zluda_dnn`/`zluda_fft`/`zluda_sparse`: bound to
  AMD ROCm (rocBLAS/MIOpen/rocFFT/rocSPARSE). Useful only as API-mapping
  templates; ignuda will build its Intel equivalents on oneMKL/oneDNN.
- `llvm_zluda` and the patched LLVM submodule: only needed for ZLUDA's
  LLVM-IR→AMDGPU path. ignuda emits SPIR-V directly and stays LLVM-free.

## Integration status

These crates are **built by the workspace** but not yet wired into ignuda's own
compiler/runtime. Migrating `crates/ptx`/`crates/ptx2spirv` onto `ptx_parser`,
and ignuda's hand-written types onto `cuda_types`, is tracked in Flowly.
